question: BMD (bone mineral density) test is done to identify_____.
solution:
The correct answer is__** osteoporosis.**__

__
 
• The BMD test can identify __**__osteoporosis__, **determine your risk for fractures (broken bones).
 
• It measures your response to osteoporosis treatment.
 
• The test can measure bone density at your hip and lumbar spine.
 
• It is just like a normal X-ray test.
